case_title: WESTERN FINANCIAL SAVINGS BANK,FSB vs. CAMBER, STEPHEN et al

docket_entries.description: PURSUANT TO CRC 1615 (C), THE AWARD OF THE ARBITRATOR IS HEREBY ENTERED AS JUDGMENT. IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF WESTERN FINANCIAL SAVINGS BANK,FSB RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT CAMBER, STEPHEN $5,096.36 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,096.36, AND THAT CROSS PLAINTFF STEPHEN J. CAMBER RECOVER FROM CROSS DEFENDANTS GLENN R. JACOBSON AND ANN JACOBSON IND. AND DBA PORCELLI'S ENTERPRISES $5,096.36, BUT RECOVER NOTHING FROM CROSS-DEFENDANT WESTERN FINANCIAL SAVINGS BANK. EACH PARTY BEARS THEIR OWN COST OF SUIT.
